data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, regardless of others; each of the other 24 can opt in individually. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and the rest10, catch=250+8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50; next stock is500 or100. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run optimality. Each fisher: state your exact intended catch and any conditions; others' refusal needn't veto you.
